about.paragraphOne: I'm an IT student focused on practical, business-oriented web applications: from clear marketing sites to internal dashboards, CRM systems and booking products.
about.paragraphTwo: I use AI tools as part of a disciplined development workflow, not as a substitute for engineering judgment. I manually control architecture, testing, integrations and deployment.

principles.practicalText: Business goals, real workflows and useful interfaces come before decorative complexity.
principles.accountableText: AI accelerates execution; architecture, integration, testing and deployment remain my responsibility.

skills.description: A focused toolkit for taking web products from interface to deployment.

buildMarket.title: BuildMarket Store
buildMarket.problem: Organize a large construction-products catalog and keep the journey from product discovery to checkout clear on every screen size.
buildMarket.solution: A responsive storefront structures product discovery around searchable categories, focused product details, and a predictable cart flow. Reusable components keep the catalog consistent as the assortment grows.
buildMarket.demonstrates: E-commerce interface design, catalog state management, and scalable UI component architecture.

priceTracker.title: Price Tracker Dashboard
priceTracker.problem: Bring price changes into one workspace so users can identify trends and products requiring attention without manual comparison.
priceTracker.solution: The dashboard combines current values, historical charts, comparisons, and alert thresholds in one monitoring workspace. Visual hierarchy makes significant changes visible before users inspect individual records.
priceTracker.demonstrates: Data visualization, API integration, and the design of information-dense dashboard interfaces.

botOrders.title: Bot Orders CRM
botOrders.problem: Turn incoming Telegram bot orders into a manageable operator workflow while preserving customer context throughout fulfillment.
botOrders.solution: Orders are normalized into a CRM pipeline with customer profiles, status transitions, filters, and operational context. The interface gives operators one place to track fulfillment from intake to completion.
botOrders.demonstrates: Fullstack-like business logic, CRM workflow modeling, database work, and external integrations.

salesAnalytics.title: Sales Analytics Dashboard
salesAnalytics.problem: Present sales metrics so revenue, conversion, and channel performance can be understood without manually processing source data.
salesAnalytics.solution: A KPI-first dashboard turns sales data into period comparisons, channel breakdowns, and readable trends. Filters update the analytical context without forcing users to rebuild reports.
salesAnalytics.demonstrates: Information architecture for analytics products and practical work with complex datasets.

bookingService.title: Booking Service App
bookingService.problem: Make appointment booking predictable for customers and manageable for a business across available dates and time slots.
bookingService.solution: A guided booking flow connects service selection, calendar availability, authentication, and booking management. Explicit states prevent users from choosing unavailable slots or losing context between steps.
bookingService.demonstrates: Booking and calendar logic, authentication, flow validation, and availability state management.

mediaLibrary.title: Media Library API App
mediaLibrary.problem: Combine external catalog search and personal saved lists in a resilient interface with clear loading and error states.
mediaLibrary.solution: The application wraps an external media API in a focused discovery experience with search, detailed cards, and personal lists. Loading, empty, and error states keep asynchronous behavior understandable.
mediaLibrary.demonstrates: REST API integration, asynchronous state management, and practical Vue/Nuxt development.

saasLanding.title: Animated SaaS Landing
saasLanding.problem: Present a SaaS product through an expressive but performant page where motion supports the message without obstructing conversion.
saasLanding.solution: The landing page uses controlled motion, strong content hierarchy, and repeated calls to action to explain the product without overwhelming the visitor. Responsive behavior and reduced-motion awareness protect usability.
saasLanding.demonstrates: Marketing-page implementation, motion design, reusable sections, and performance awareness.

taskManager.title: Team Task Manager
taskManager.problem: Structure collaborative work around tasks, ownership, and priorities so every participant can see current progress.
taskManager.solution: A shared task workspace connects role-based access, assignments, priorities, statuses, and progress tracking. Consistent task states make responsibility and next actions visible across the team.
taskManager.demonstrates: A fullstack-like application with role-based behavior, business states, and collaborative workflows.
